description: The quote of a calendar day: the quote number is (day of the year, 1-366, of the Gregorian date) modulo the number of quotes, plus 1; quotes are numbered 1..N in the quote file. The same date always gives the same quote on every platform; the date is the device's date for 'today' or the chosen day.

inputs.quote_count: number of quotes in the quote file (300)
